title: Endless Terminals
input: Its original task-generation settings, prompts and configured model.
native_output: Task JSON, initial/completion tests, Apptainer definitions and sampled solutions.

conversion.approach: Use the upstream converter first; compare native and converted verifier outcomes on identical initial and solution states.

known_limitations: The conversion path has its own model/sampling requirements. Initial-state build success is distinct from completion-verifier validity.

why_this_order: Establish the simpler Apptainer generation path and its existing Harbor conversion before TMax.
